user.title: Connect to your IPTV server
user.description: Enter your Xtream login. On some IPTV panels the password field is actually a playlist ID. Leave the password blank and enter an API token to pick a playlist by name instead.

data_description.username: Xtream username. Many panels default this to admin.

error.no_playlists: No playlists found for this token
error.password_or_token: Enter a password, or an API token to choose a playlist

init.title: Options
init.description: Channel players and QuadStream are optional. A channel player is a media_player whose sources are this playlist's channels, for remote-first cards. QuadStream needs the username and secret of a private stream set.

data.remote_players: TVs to add a channel player for
data.remote_groups: Channel groups on the channel player

data_description.remote_players: One media_player entity per TV. Picking a source on it casts that channel to the TV.
data_description.remote_groups: Leave empty to list every channel.

error.quadstream_auth: QuadStream rejected the username or secret
